Qasam hai un (farishton) ki jo (kafiron ki rooh) sakhti se khinchte hain.
Aur jo (momino ki rooh ki) girah narmi se khol dete hain.
Phir (fiza mein) tere hue jate hain.
Phir tezi se lpkte hain.
Phir jo hukum milta hai us (ko poora karne) ka intezam karte hain.
Ke jis din bhonchal (har cheez ko) hila dale ga.
Phir us ke baad ek aur jhatka aaye ga.
Us din bohat se dil laraz rahe hon ge.
Un ki aankhein jhuki hui hon gi.
Yeh (kafir log) kehte hain ke : kya hum pehli wali halat par lota diye jayen ge ?
Kya us waqt jab hum boseeda haddiyon mein tabdeel hochke hon ge ?
Kehte hain ke : agar aisa hua to yeh bare ghate ki wapsi hogi.
Haqeeqat to yeh hai ke woh bas ek zoar ki aawaz hogi.
Jis ke baad woh achanak ek khle maidan mein hon ge.
(ae payghumbar) kya tumhein musa ka waqa pahuncha hai ?
Jab un ke Parwardigar ne unhein toi ki muqaddas wadi mein aawaz di thi.
Ke : Firaun ke paas chale jao, us ne bohat sarkashi ikhtiyar kar rkhi hai.
Aur us se kaho ke kya tumhein yeh khwahish hai ke tum sanwar jao ?
Aur yeh ke mein tumhein tumhare Parwardigar ka raasta dikhaoon to tumhare dil mein khof paida hojaye ?
Chunanche musa ne us ko bari zabardast nishani dkhaii
Phir bhi us ne (unhein) jhutlaya, aur kehna nahin maana.
Phir dor dhoop karne ke liye palta.
Phir sab ko aktha kiya aur aawaz lagayi.
Aur kaha ke : mein tumhara ali darje ka Parwardigar hon.
Nateeja yeh hua ke Allah ne use aakhirat aur duniya ke azab mein pakar liya.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke us waqiye mein us shaks ke liye bari ibrat hai jo Allah ka khof dil mein rakhta ho.
(insano) kya tumhein paida karna ziyada mushkil hai ya aasman ko ? Us ko Allah ne banaya hai.
Us ki bulandi athaii hui hai, phir use theek kiya hai.
Aur us ki raat ko andheri banaya hai, aur us ke din ki dhoop bahar nikal di hai.
Aur zameen ko us ke baad bchha diya hai.
Us mein se us ka pani aur us ka chara nikala hai.
Aur paharon ko garh diya hai.
Taake tumhein aur tumhare maweshiyon ko faida pahunchaye.
Phir jab woh sab se bara hungama barpa hoga.
Jis din insan apna sara kiya dhara yaad kare ga.
Aur dozakh har dekhne wale ke samne zaahir kardi jaye gi.
To woh jis ne sarkashi ki thi.
Aur duniya ki zindagi ko tarjeeh di thi.
To dozakh hi us ka thikana hogi.
Lekin woh jo apne Parwardigar ke samne khra hone ka khof rakhta tha aur apne nafs ko buri khwahishat se rokta tha.
To jannat hi us ka thikana hogi.
Yeh log tum se qayamat ki ghri ke bare mein puchte hain ke woh kab qayam hogi ?
Tumhara yeh baat biyan karne mein kya kaam ?
Us ka ilm to tumhare Parwardigar par khatam hai.
Jo shaks us se darta ho, tum to sirf us ko khabardar karne wale ho.
Jis din yeh us ko dekh len ge, us din unhein aisa maloom hoga jaise woh (duniya mein ya qabar mein) ek shaam ya ek subah se ziyada nahin rahe.
